|lore=
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Galen's Fighter]]; it is the current text. The images here are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-rogueshadow-pre.gif]]) and the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-59-front-master.png]]); both print this title and text. The card image ([[:File:VB4-D-galensfighter-pre.gif]]) and release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-58-Rogue_Shadow.png]]) of Galen's Fighter show the original (see [[Galen's Fighter]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Galen's Fighter]]): printed as “•Galen's Fighter”, text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip 58)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found), page 8, slip 58. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref>: “May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. If Black Leader piloting, adds one battle destiny. If it just took off, may use its hyperspeed and land. Immune to attrition < 7 if Galen on table, even while landed.” The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed the same title (“Galen's Fighter”) and text.<ref name="cl-1240_59-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013)</ref> The Players Committee card image of Galen's Fighter prints the same text.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): On 29 January 2013 the [[Players Committee]] announced the persona-name change “Galen’s Fighter ---> Rogue Shadow”, effective immediately (old slips stayed tournament-legal; non-gameplay lore was removed; “Each of the cards will retain their gametext and characteristics”)<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>. The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) retitled the card “•''Rogue Shadow''” and changed “If Black Leader piloting” to “If Juno Eclipse piloting”: “May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. If Juno Eclipse piloting, adds one battle destiny. If it just took off, may use its hyperspeed and land. Immune to attrition < 7 if Galen on table, even while landed.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=55, page 55. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=55 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee card image of Rogue Shadow prints the same title and text.
|hatnote=For the original printed text, see [[Galen's Fighter]].
